summary: Lower == through the ECMAScript IsLooselyEqual algorithm.

target.notes: Must implement null/undefined equivalence, Boolean-to-Number conversion, String/Number and String/BigInt rules, object ToPrimitive, and Number/BigInt mathematical comparison.

caveats: Do not map to C# == or Convert.ChangeType.
